requirements: The proposal is activated by a fresh exact terminal_parent_qualification_v3 replay and the canonical full-1G lease namespace is absent.
A new content-addressed candidate tree is derived from the exact sealed q1 source without modifying or linking writable state back into the parent tree.
The four overlay files and integration patch exactly match the review hashes and a complete source-difference manifest names no path outside the frozen write surface.
The materialized source passes a future C++ syntax/build gate under the exact q1 compiler, defines, target, dependency, floating-point, and one-CPU contract.
Two clean builds from independent empty build roots produce identical binaries and complete dependency closures.
A synthetic phase fixture reaches starts 0/64 and closures 32/96, proves the first changed prediction is x_(s+33), and a negative one-event-early mutation fails.
P equals the sealed q1 parent on the fixture and K equals P in every future-affecting partition after canonical scratch clear.
The complete incremental compressed source, build, runtime, framing, and receipt package is at most 65,536 bytes before any archive arm runs.

population_ladder.authorization: only after a complete valid 250KB decision passes every implementation, identity, exactness, repeat, resource, and package predicate
only after a valid 1MB F archive beats both P and S under the frozen decision rule

identity: runner, schemas, resource guards, and dependency manifests by path/bytes/sha256

state_partitions.dynamic: Byte-LSTM hidden_ plus every LstmLayer running cell state
state_partitions.parameters: recurrent dense/symbol/gamma/beta masters plus output masters and compile-selected fp16 shadows
state_partitions.optimizer: all recurrent first/second moments and update_steps_ counters
state_partitions.ordinary_tape: layer_input_, input_history_, output_, h_hist_, err0_, recurrent native histories, native epochs, and ordinary gradient scratch
state_partitions.external_predictor: mixer, SSE, context tables, q1 file-backed state, frontend, and reversible transform state
state_partitions.midpoint: capture, gradient, replay, detached-control, phase, arm, and canonical-clear state

rolling_checkpoints.coordinates: start, every 64 modeled events, and terminal
required_per_checkpoint: arithmetic low/high and payload prefix bytes/sha256

midpoint_update_manifest: recurrent gradient and hypothetical-or-committed Adam aggregate sha256
resources: maximum cgroup memory.current and memory.peak bytes
incremental live bytes relative to P
encode/decode runtime and normalized runtime eligibility

cross_arm_predicates.P_parent_identity: P integer probabilities, payload, archive, modeled inverse, raw inverse, and terminal future-affecting state equal the exact q1 parent on the identical scope.
cross_arm_predicates.K_P_identity: At every rolling checkpoint and terminal, K equals P in integer probabilities, coder state, payload prefix, dynamic state, parameters, optimizer, ordinary tape, external predictor state, payload, archive, decoded modeled stream, and raw inverse. Midpoint scratch must equal the canonical-clear value at each 64-event checkpoint.
cross_arm_predicates.F_repeat: F run 1 equals F run 2 in every output hash, update manifest, rolling checkpoint, resource-policy decision, and terminal state partition.
cross_arm_predicates.S_repeat: S run 1 equals S run 2 under the same equality surface.
cross_arm_predicates.F_S_source_difference: The materialized arm-difference manifest proves the only F/S code/data choice is target_index=(local+16)%32; runtime state hashes are not required to match after their first different update.
cross_arm_predicates.all_arm_exactness: Every arm independently completes encode, decode, modeled-stream equality, exact raw inverse, dependency closure, and resource observation without a non-finite or synchronization abort.

decision_equations.F_gain_bytes: P arithmetic archive bytes - F arithmetic archive bytes
decision_equations.S_gain_bytes: P arithmetic archive bytes - S arithmetic archive bytes
decision_equations.F_beats_P: F arithmetic archive bytes < P arithmetic archive bytes
decision_equations.F_beats_S: F arithmetic archive bytes < S arithmetic archive bytes
decision_equations.resources_within_limits: every arm has tree RSS <= 9,765,625 KiB, cgroup peak <= 10,000,000,000 bytes, incremental live <= 268,435,456 bytes, max logical CPUs <= 1, and valid scratch accounting
decision_equations.promotion: all pre-archive gates, P identity, K/P identity, exactness, repeats, F_beats_P, F_beats_S, resources, and package are true

fail_closed: A missing arm, repeat, file, hash, checkpoint, state partition, update row, inverse, guard receipt, dependency, or package member makes the decision invalid rather than false-positive.
The first P/K mismatch terminalizes implementationClosurePass and forbids F/S scientific interpretation on that source identity.
A non-finite value, event/epoch disagreement, K replay mismatch, encoder/decoder update mismatch, or incomplete population aborts before promotion.
No gain is extrapolated between populations and no separately measured gain is added to another mechanism.
claim_boundary: This contract freezes future evidence fields and comparisons only.
It does not provide materialization, build, fixture, coder, archive, or lease authority.
It does not certify the review overlay as compilable or correct.
Every future oracle result remains zero objective credit even if scientifically positive.
